text:
Predicates:
Allowed(x) ::: Pets are allowed in building x.
DepositRequired(x) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in building x.
EqualDeposit(x) ::: The security deposit in building x is equal to one month's rent or more.
Cat(x) ::: x is a cat.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
MoveInWith(x, y) ::: x moves in with y.
Rent(x, y) ::: The monthly rent at building x is $y.
LessThan(x, y) ::: x is less than y.
WillRent(x, y) ::: Person x will rent an apartment in building y.
Premises:
∃x (Managed(x) ∧ Allowed(x)) ::: Pets are allowed in some managed buildings.
∀x (Managed(x) ∧ DepositRequired(x) → EqualDeposit(x)) ::: A deposit is required to rent an apartment in a managed building.
Cat(fluffy) ∧ Pet(fluffy) ∧ Cat(tom) ∧ Pet(tom) ∧ MoveInWith(fluffy, tom) ::: Fluffy is Tom's cat. Cats are pets.
Managed(oliveGarden) ∧ Rent(oliveGarden, 2000) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building. The monthly rent at the Olive Garden is $2000.
∀x (WillRent(tom, x) ↔ (MoveInWith(fluffy, tom) ∧ LessThan(Deposit(x), 1500))) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if and only if he is allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
2000$ > 1500$ ::: 2000$ is more than $1500.
Conclusion:
EqualDeposit(oliveGarden) ∨ LessThan(Deposit(oliveGarden), 2000) ::: The security deposit at the Olive Garden is either $2000 or more.
